label: directed communication to
definition: X directs an utterance, request, advice or explicit message to Y.
scope_notes: Ask, tell, urge, persuade and address-to form the dominant communication component, preserving prior scope. Unspecified send, submit or give objects are ambiguous alone because they can be noncommunicative. Sporting player roles do not independently establish communication.

facts.reason: Bush explicitly asks and tells Congress and gives an address to it; unspecified submission and sending are additional paths.
Mr. Greenspan explicitly tells, urges and advises Congress and testifies before it.
Riley starts, plays, removes and suspends Anthony, with a tailor/barber comparison; none establishes communication addressed to Anthony.
Ewing is Knicks center and leads the team. The only potentially communicative path is gives-to, whose omitted object could be advice or a noncommunicative contribution such as points.
facts.reviewer_question: What does Ewing give the Knicks in the gives-to rows: an explicit message/advice or a noncommunicative sporting contribution?

facts.reason: The Administration explicitly asks, urges, persuades and tells Congress; submit and send paths are additional.
